persona_summary: Mateo (29) is a Spanish software engineer who moved to Sint-Gillis three weeks ago for a job at Nexlane. He prefers English and is in the middle of his first Belgian paperwork.
diary_opener: Hey Mateo, I've already lived your next month. I only had three months to apply for the tax regime for newcomers, and the clock was already ticking.

cards.title: This month I paid twice for two bank accounts
cards.body: I moved money back and forth between Spain and Belgium. With everything in one place I'd have saved about €150 in transfer and account fees.

actions.title: Bring your everyday banking to KBC
actions.body: Euro transfers to Spain are free. We move your Spanish direct debits over too, so you can close the extra account when you're ready.

cards.title: Three weeks in, I was still paying my doctor in full myself
cards.body: Without a health insurance fund I got nothing back from the doctor, pharmacy or hospital. I should have joined right away.
